courses.note: The CS option requires no software engineering course (CS 3x is Introduction to Software Design in C, a programming-practice course), so the capstone slot is used: an undergraduate thesis (CS 80abc) or a project of at least 18 units (CS 81abc or CS 82). These are supervised-research courses, so no common syllabus is expected.
